messages:
Maya: Heads up — discovered a permissions regression in the Console. A user with Viewer role could rename projects from the UI. Repro steps below.
Ian: repro steps?
Maya: Steps: sign in as viewer -> Projects -> Settings -> Rename -> Save. It succeeds. API call from UI returned 200 and body {ok:true}. Backend API returns 403 when called directly.
Rob: whoa. So UI thinks it succeeded but backend denies when using raw token? Can you paste the network trace / response payload?
Maya: Network trace: `POST /api/console/projects/rename` 200, response `{"ok":true, "project":{"id":"proj_123","name":"new"}}`. Backend audit log shows event "project.rename" with actor maya.viewer@test. No explicit policy decision recorded.
Sophia: Did we roll any RBAC role changes recently? We updated role aliases for project-level perms yesterday to add metadata_view to Viewer. That should be read-only. @Chris did you merge anything?
Chris: I merged role-aliases PR to reduce duplicate checks: `role-aliases: project:* -> project:*`. I thought metadata_view was read-only. I'll inspect mapping.
Ian: frontend quick check: we gate the Rename button with `canUpdateProject` derived from `permissions.project.update`. Might be our mapping is wrong and viewer is getting `project.update`. I've opened a quick PR to add an explicit policy check before firing the rename endpoint from the UI: github.com/redwood/console/pull/4321
Rob: sounds like both sides need fixes. Backend needs to ensure server-side policy enforcement is authoritative (UI client must never be source of truth). Also audit logs must record policy evaluation.
Maya: Agreed. Also audit trail currently missing signed entries for denies. Auditor flagged this for compliance (GDPR customer wants full, tamper-evident trail). auditor-bot: @Maya note: compliance ticket 8672 open for audit integrity.
Chris: Investigating server policy evaluator. Early finding: alias resolution accidentally mapped `project:metadata_update` to the same internal capability code as `project:update` during the refactor (bad constant reuse). Patch in progress.
Rob: I'll prepare a hotfix to revert the alias refactor and add a migration to backfill audit entries that might be missing signatures.
Ian: Frontend PR now guarding button plus a backend call to check `policy.v1.check('project:update')` before sending rename.
Sophia: Prioritize this as P0 for security. We need ETA and mitigation plan. Any data exfil?
Maya: No evidence of exfil; only some project names changed for a handful of test accounts. Will run a query to enumerate projects renamed in the window.
Rob: Mitigation plan: 1) hotfix role-alias revert, 2) backend policy patch to correct mapping + ensure 403 for unauthorized, 3) frontend gating patch, 4) backfill and sign audit logs, 5) KMS key rotation as precaution.
Chris: Confirmed bug: constant `PERM_PROJECT_UPDATE` accidentally pointed to `perm.metadata.update` enum value. Pushing fix.
Rob: PR #4330 created for hotfix (revert + tests). Deploying now.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: hotfix/console-perm-4330 at 1860001500 by Rob
Rob: Deployment success, 1860001525.
Maya: Verified in staging: UI no longer shows rename for Viewer, backend returns 403 when trying raw rename, and audit entry created with signature (log_id: abc123).
Sophia: Great. Can we run a backfill to sign the previously created audit entries? Compliance wants tamper-evidence for the whole window.
Rob: Backfill job queued. ETA 2h for backfill to complete and signature verification. PR #4335 for backfill script.
Chris: Ops will rotate KMS keys after backfill completes. We'll do staging key rotation first and then prod.
Maya: Legal/compliance — low impact, but document in internal incident log and notify customers if any public-facing change.
Sophia: Marking this P0 -> resolved when backfill + KMS rotation done.
Maya: Thanks team :tada: Please paste PR links and RFC for role-alias tests so we don't regress.
Rob: PRs: 4330 (hotfix), 4335 (backfill), frontend 4321. Tests added under `roles/alias_tests`.
Maya: Closing thread after final confirmation.
